limitBody: That's the maximum for one account. To create another project, leave one of your current teams or hand over the Founder role in it to someone else.
name.title: What shall we call your project?
name.description: A working name is perfectly fine — you can change it any time.
hasIdea.title: Do you already know what you want to build?
hasIdea.description: Your answer decides where we start.
hasIdea.yesDescription: You'll describe it now and we'll go straight to checking whether it makes sense.
hasIdea.noDescription: We'll take you through about fifteen minutes of questions, after which you'll have a first outline.
idea.title: Tell us what it's about
idea.help: It doesn't have to be perfect. In the next steps Vairo will help you sharpen it.
categoriesHelp: This decides what Vairo will ask about during validation. General validation is always on — the rest only adds to it.
tagsDescription: Select all that apply. This helps others find you in Social.
errors.name: Project name: 2–80 characters.
errors.idea: Idea description: at least a few sentences, or leave it empty.
errors.limit: You already have {count} teams — that's the maximum for one account. Leave one to create a new one.
